description_compelling: Two states sign a formal bilateral pact — investment treaty, defense agreement, visa regime, status-of-forces document — recording a new institutional relationship. Trade openness, FDI flows, and rule-of-law metrics frame the diplomatic ground. Common between major economies and their second-tier partners, and across former-colonial-power relationships being repositioned.
